flagged.evidence: The proof asserts: “The same argument directly with the coarse-cell mass under P0 gives p_{P0,σ}(x)≥c'''b_n^{a-1}.” This item assumes no interval-mass lower bound and does not define a. For a counterexample, take p0(x)=C exp(-1/x²-1/(1-x)²) on (0,1), zero elsewhere, with K=[0,1]. It is a bounded smooth density with J=∫(p0'')²/p0 finite, so the Gaussian-convolution lemma gives h(p0,p0*φσ)≤Cσ² as required. But p0*φσ(0)≤Cσ⁻¹exp(-√2/σ), since 1/z²+z²/(2σ²)≥√2/σ; this decays faster than every power of σ and contradicts the claimed polynomial lower bound for σ=s_-b_n.
